title: FACT: A Multimodal Force-Action-Track Foundation Model for Human-to-Robot Dexterity
authors: Zhi Cao, Yining Hong, Jiaolong Yang, Yejin Choi, Li Fei-Fei, Jiajun Wu, Huang Huang

tldr.zh: FACT 用人类视触觉示范联合预训练视频—轨迹—动作粗规划器与力—动作细化器，在执行中结合最新触觉，共同预测未来指尖力并修正尚未执行的动作。
tldr.en: FACT jointly pretrains a video–track–action coarse planner and a force–action refiner on human visual–tactile demonstrations, using fresh tactile feedback during execution to jointly predict future fingertip forces and refine unexecuted actions.

evaluation_scope.zh: 以 2,000 小时人类 EgoForce 数据和 100 小时机器人示范联合预训练，两个模块使用流匹配。Wan2.2 视频主干根据指令、视觉与机器人状态联合预测视频、轨迹和粗动作；细化器读取粗动作、规划缓存、当前指尖力与受力历史，通过双向注意力联合去噪未来力与动作。20 Hz 执行动作、5 Hz 刷新触觉，复用粗规划缓存并固定已执行前缀，仅细化未执行部分，权重不在线更新。动作是双臂末端位姿变化与手指关节目标，预测力不作为控制参考。双 Sharpa Wave 手评测十项任务，每项另用 10 条机器人＋90 条人类示范微调，并非零样本部署。项目页的代码与数据仍标为 Coming Soon，未核实可下载的模型权重。
evaluation_scope.en: Joint pretraining uses 2,000 hours of human EgoForce data and 100 hours of robot demonstrations; both modules use flow matching. A Wan2.2 video backbone jointly predicts video, tracks and coarse actions from instructions, vision and robot state. The refiner reads coarse actions, cached planner features, current fingertip force and force history, using bidirectional attention to jointly denoise future force and actions. Actions execute at 20 Hz with tactile refreshes at 5 Hz; cached coarse plans and a clamped executed prefix allow refinement of only the unexecuted suffix, without online weight updates. Outputs are bimanual end-effector pose changes and finger-joint targets; predicted force is not a control reference. Ten tasks use two Sharpa Wave hands, with an additional 10 robot plus 90 human demonstrations per task for fine-tuning, rather than zero-shot deployment. The project page still labels code and data Coming Soon; downloadable model weights have not been verified.
